home.subtitle: Alchemists of the Great Year
home.tagline: Rules wiki for players at the table.
home.intro.summary: Kismeta: Alchemists of the Great Year is a strategic card-and-dice game where you and up to three friends take on the roles of rival Alchemists. Your quest is to complete the Great Work, transforming your Philosopher's Stone from Lead into Gold. Travel through the Cosmic Ages of the Great Year, pursuing this transformation under the watchful gaze of the Fates, the eternal guardians of the Crucible of Kismeta.
home.intro.playTimeValue: 1st Play/Quickplay ~ 1–2 hrs. | Standard ~ 2–3 hrs. | Magnus Alchemist ~ 3+ hrs.

game.tva.summary: Kismeta: The Veiled Ascent is a tarot card game where you ascend through the Aethereal Veil. Each round, build a three-card spread and try to outscore the Table's hand without going over 50 — victories move you upward through seven chakras while defeats deepen your corruption. Reach enlightenment before corruption overwhelms you. Coming soon as a physical game and on Google Play.
